notes: WArmy 0.4.12 — relay TLS trust establishment (self-signed certificate fingerprint pinning with first-use manual verification, persistent per-relay pins, automatic mismatch rejection and re-verification, plus CA/domain verification mode); fixes the dsh update check and one-click install on Windows (Node >= 18.20 EINVAL when spawning npm.cmd, now resolved through npm-cli.js with asynchronous spawn so it never blocks the main process); the diagnostic log opens in its own window; the help drawer opens from the rail/list seam and is fully invisible when closed; consistent context-menu ordering across session types; a larger workhorse settings window; knowledge panel rework. Verified by a 160-turn / 24 MB long-context stress test against a local 128K Ollama model: zero failures, zero anomalies, a stable context budget, and correct memory retrieval whenever recall/retrieve is invoked. The in-app updater downloads only changed blocks with unchanged SHA-256 verification.
